component.name: mudcrab
component.summary: Install and write modlists for Oblivion

description.p: mudcrab installs a modlist for The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion into a Mod Organizer 2 instance from one window: it reads the list, asks its questions, downloads what it can, checks everything, and installs. A list's author can read and edit it there too: each mod's files, the load order with masters, conflicts, installers and notes.
Every step is one of the mudcrab command line's commands, shown as it runs.
